terms.designation: Chapter 13, Statistical Aspects of Measuring and Sampling

definitions.content: The more accurate petroleum measurement becomes, the more its practitioners stand in need of statistical methods to express residual uncertainties. This chapter covers the application of statistical methods to petroleum measurement and sampling. Chapter 13 is in preparation. The following portion now covers the subject of statistical aspects of measuring and sampling and is included in the manual.
